luis (acme): Hey team — we're seeing 429s and p95 token latency jumps on our eu2 dedicated pool (eu2-dedicated-7) starting ~2026-03-15T03:02Z. Requests fail ~1 in 20, tail latencies >5s. Any quick checks?

sara (support): Sorry about that, luis. Can you paste a sample request id + timestamp? Also which model + quantization are you hitting?

luis (acme): Request id: rq_202603150302_9f3a, model: llama-2-13b-q4f16, burst qps ~45, typical p95 ~300ms. Auth succeeds, billing shows normal. No recent config changes on our side.

sara (support): Thanks. We're seeing 429s for that request id in our logs too. I'm going to open an internal triage and ask infra to look at the dedicated pool noise. @mike can you check MIG sibling contention signals?

mike (eng-runtime): I see correlated SM utilization spikes on node n-1472 around the same window. Suspicious of MIG sibling bandwidth thrash. Can you run a quick repro: run a 30s steady small-batch load from a non-prod tenant on the same pool while we capture nvidia-smi dmon + telegraf? Command:

```
# from a machine with our gen-load tool
gen-load --target eu2-dedicated-7 --qps 40 --model llama-2-13b-q4f16 --batch-size 1 --duration 30s --trace rq_test_capture
```

Collect `/var/log/redwood/runtime/*.log` and `nvidia-smi dmon -s u -d 1` output.

Also run `cat /sys/class/mig/*/slice_info` to confirm MIG slices.

If you can't run that on prod, we'll schedule an isolated repro on a warm node.

jen (oncall): We tried an autoscale bump earlier but p95 remained. Suspect fractional MIG packing causing cross-slice IO thrash. @ashok can we isolate a node to a single tenant for 1h and run the capture?

ashok (infra): I can isolate n-1472 at 06:00 UTC for 1h. I'll pin the tenant, add host-level perf counters (SM, L2 bw) and enable kernel debug sampling.

sara (support): Thanks. Action items: (1) @ashok isolate node n-1472 at 06:00 UTC; (2) @luis if you can run `gen-load` repro during that window, please do and attach logs; (3) @mike will analyze SM/L2/time-correlated traces and propose mitigation (pack different MIG config or force NUMA-aware placement). I'll keep you updated.

luis (acme): Will run repro at 06:05 UTC and upload logs to the case. Quick question: any workaround meantime? Lowering qps helps but not ideal.

mike (eng-runtime): Short-term: drop to qps 20 or route to an alternate dedicated pool (eu2-dedicated-3) if available. Mid-term: we can change packing policy to avoid fractional slice co-location for this tenant. We'll report back with patch to scheduler.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-4728 - 'eu2-dedicated-7 noisy neighbor capture' and linked logs. Assignee: mike

sara (support): Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer after the isolation run and attach INF-4728. Please paste the trace id when done. :thumbsup:

luis (acme): Trace id from repro: rq_test_capture_20260315_0605. Uploaded logs to case. Thanks all.

mike (eng-runtime): Got the artifacts. Initial look: SM saturation + L2 bandwidth oscillation on neighbor slice, KV cache misses spiking. Will follow up with a plan in INF-4728 by EOD.

jen (oncall): Noted. If mitigation isn't immediate we'll failover luis to eu2-dedicated-3 tonight to avoid customer SLA breaches.

ashok (infra): Isolation complete. Logs stored under /mnt/captures/INF-4728/4405001234.tar.gz

sara (support): Closing loop for now — monitoring. Reopen if you see further 429s. :)
